how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply online for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.
Visit the official Jharkhand recruitment website: https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in
Locate the DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 (Advertisement No. 01/2026) application link, available on the portal maintained by JAP IT, Ranchi, Jharkhand.
Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category-related details.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature as specified in the notification.

Upload all required documents, including educational certificates, training certificates, mark sheets, category/residential certificates (if claiming reservation), date-of-birth (matriculation) certificate, computer proficiency certificate (if applicable), and experience certificates (with salary payment proof and bank statement).
Upload Aadhaar card details as identity proof.
Pay the applicable application fee online through the payment link provided on the website.
Submit the application and retain a copy/printout for future reference.
Applications will be accepted online only; offline or postal applications will not be accepted, as stated in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 is post-specific. Candidates should check the essential qualification for their intended post carefully before applying, as requirements vary across nursing, paramedical, technical, and counselling roles. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for the complete, post-wise qualification and marking scheme, as some posts also include desirable/preferential qualifications not summarised here for brevity.

rows.essential_qualification_summary: 10+2/Intermediate with 3 years General Nursing and Midwifery Training from a Govt-recognised institution; registered under Jharkhand Nursing Council; at least 2 years' hospital/health institution experience
Same as Staff Nurse qualification above
10+2 or equivalent with completed ANM course from an institution recognised by the Government and approved by INC; registered under Jharkhand Nursing Council
10+2/Intermediate; Diploma or certificate course in Operation Theatre Technician; registered under Pharmacy Council, Jharkhand; at least 1 year hospital/health institution experience

rows.post: Oxygen Operator – PSA Plant DH Godda
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Diploma in Engineering or equivalent technical certification (Mechanical/Electrical)/B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical); at least 1 year experience operating and maintaining oxygen generation plants or relevant field

Graduation in any discipline with at least 1-year diploma in Computer Application/PG Diploma in Computer Application/DOEACC "O" Level/ITI/IDTR or Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc(IT)/B.Sc(Computer Science)/DOEACC "A" level; minimum 2 years' post-qualification relevant experience
Two years' Diploma Course in Optometry or trained as an Ophthalmic Assistant in an NPCB-recognised Govt hospital; familiarity with computer and internet use

rows.post: Pharmacist (RBSK / RNTCP / Drug Store / UPHC Mahagama)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institute; registered under Pharmacy Council; computer proficiency (MS Office) and internet; at least 2 years' hospital/health institution experience (except UPHC Mahagama, where experience is not specified)

Graduate; Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent from a Govt-recognised institute; permanent two-wheeler driving licence; certificate course in computer operation (minimum 2 months); minimum 1 year RNTCP experience desirable
10+2/Intermediate with Diploma in X-Ray Technology/Radiology from a Govt-recognised institute with 2 years' experience in a medical lab; registered under Jharkhand Paramedical Council
Post Graduate; 1 year experience in communication/ACSM/public-private partnership/health projects; permanent two-wheeler driving licence

Graduate, preferably from biology stream (a science graduate at Class XII considered if biology-stream candidate not available); 1 year experience in vector-borne disease; valid two-wheeler driving licence

Graduate, OR Intermediate (10+2) in Science with experience as MPW/LHV/ANM/Health Worker plus a certificate/higher course in health education/counselling, or a Tuberculosis Health Visitor's course; certificate course in computer operations (minimum 2 months)
Matriculation (essential); 2 years' hospital work experience desirable

10+2 or equivalent; one-and-a-half-year certificate course in Multi Rehabilitation from a recognised institute; registered as Rehabilitation personnel under the Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992

First or Second Class M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/M.Phil Psychiatric Social Work/M.A./M.Sc in Psychology, or second class M.A./M.S.W in Medical Psychiatric Social Work/M.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing, from an institute recognised as per the Indian Nursing Council

Medical Graduate with Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Preventive & Social Medicine/Public Health or Epidemiology (MD, MPH, DPH, MAE, etc.); OR any medical graduate with 2 years' experience in Epidemiology/Public Health; minimum 2 years' experience in public health issues

rows.post: Lab Technician (IDSP / MFP Fluorosis / UPHC Mahagama)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: 10+2/Intermediate with Diploma in Lab Technician from a Govt-recognised institute with 1 year experience; registered under Jharkhand Paramedical Council

rows.post: District Cold Chain Handler (revised as per corrigendum dated 31.07.2026)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: 12th or Intermediate with Science; 3 years' experience of handling vaccines in Cold Chain

Postgraduate Degree in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human Development, OR Diploma in Nursing with minimum 1 year experience in the field of adolescent work; knowledge of adolescent developmental stage; good working knowledge of MS Office (block-level position)

rows.post: Counsellor (Blood Bank / NPCDCS) / RMNCH FP Counsellor
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Master's/Bachelor's Degree in Social Work/Public Administration/Psychology/Sociology/Home Science/Hospital & Health Management; 1 year work experience in health sector or relevant field; basic computer skills
Female candidates only; Master's/Bachelor's degree in Food and Nutrition/Home Science (Hons/Pass); 1 year experience in health sector or relevant field; basic computer skills; data management skills

content_sections.heading: DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 will be made through a merit list prepared on the basis of the following marking scheme, totalling 100 marks: As per the notification: if, after scrutiny of applications, the number of applications received for any post is fewer than 10, the merit list will be prepared based on educational and training marks only, without a written test/skill test. If more than 10 applications are received after scrutiny, a Written Test/Skill Test will be conducted, and marks from education, training, and the written/skill test will be combined to prepare the merit list. The final merit list will be approved by the District Selection Committee, Godda, and published on the official Godda district website, https://godda.nic.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 refers to the contract-based recruitment drive by the District Health Society, Godda under the National Health Mission for 33 posts across various health institutions and the District Hospital in Godda district, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 64 vacancies are available across 33 different posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30.08.2026. Applications opened on 06.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements differ by post, ranging from Matriculation (for Hospital/Sanitary Attendants) to postgraduate and professional medical/paramedical qualifications (for posts like Epidemiologist and Clinical Psychologist). Full post-wise qualification details are listed in the eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years for all categories. The maximum age limit ranges from 35 to 40 years, depending on category, calculated as on 01.01.2026. Full details are given in the age limit section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹400 for General/BC-I/BC-II/EWS candidates and ₹200 for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in by registering, filling the application form, uploading the required documents and photograph, and paying the applicable fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark scheme covering 10th marks, 12th marks, essential qualification, relevant higher qualification, and a Written Test/Skill Test (conducted only if more than 10 applications are received for a post after scrutiny).
